# Apache Pulsar

> Apache Pulsar is a distributed, open source pub-sub messaging and streaming platform for
> real-time workloads. It provides multi-tenant, high-throughput, low-latency messaging with
> durable storage, a schema registry, tiered storage, and stream processing.

The documentation is published at <https://pulsar.apache.org/docs/> for every supported release.
Version-less `/docs/` links below are redirected by the site to the documentation of the latest
release.

## Documentation

- [Get started](https://pulsar.apache.org/docs/getting-started-home/): Install Pulsar locally, in Docker, or on Kubernetes, and run a first cluster.
- [Concepts and architecture](https://pulsar.apache.org/docs/concepts-overview/): Tenants, namespaces, topics, brokers, and the BookKeeper storage layer.
- [Scalable topics](https://pulsar.apache.org/docs/concepts-scalable-topics/): Partitioned and non-persistent topics.
- [Pulsar schema](https://pulsar.apache.org/docs/schema-overview/): Schema registry, schema types, and schema evolution.
- [Pulsar Functions](https://pulsar.apache.org/docs/functions-overview/): Write and operate lightweight stream processing functions.
- [Pulsar IO](https://pulsar.apache.org/docs/io-overview/): Connectors that move data between Pulsar and external systems.
- [Tiered storage](https://pulsar.apache.org/docs/tiered-storage-overview/): Offload topic data to long-term storage.
- [Transactions](https://pulsar.apache.org/docs/txn-why/): Exactly-once semantics with transactional producers and consumers.
- [Deployment](https://pulsar.apache.org/docs/install-deploy-upgrade-landing/): Install, deploy, upgrade, and migrate Pulsar clusters.
- [Administration](https://pulsar.apache.org/docs/administration-zk-bk/): Operate ZooKeeper, BookKeeper, brokers, and namespaces.
- [Observability](https://pulsar.apache.org/docs/administration-stats/): Metrics, monitoring, and diagnostics.
- [Security](https://pulsar.apache.org/docs/security-overview/): Authentication, authorization, and encryption.
- [Performance](https://pulsar.apache.org/docs/performance-pulsar-perf/): Benchmark and tune Pulsar.
- [Client libraries](https://pulsar.apache.org/docs/client-libraries/): Java, Go, Python, Node.js, C++, .NET, WebSocket, and REST clients.
- [Admin API](https://pulsar.apache.org/docs/admin-api-get-started/): Manage tenants, namespaces, topics, and functions over HTTP.
- [Adaptors](https://pulsar.apache.org/docs/adaptors-kafka/): Kafka, Spark, and Storm adaptors.
- [Tutorials](https://pulsar.apache.org/docs/how-to-landing/): Task-oriented guides.
- [Development](https://pulsar.apache.org/docs/developers-landing/): Contribute to the Pulsar codebase and work on the source tree.
- [Reference](https://pulsar.apache.org/docs/reference-landing/): Configuration, metrics, and CLI references.

## Additional resources

- [Documentation home](https://pulsar.apache.org/docs/): Documentation for the latest Pulsar release.
- [Release highlights](https://pulsar.apache.org/docs/release-highlights/): Notable changes in recent releases.
- [Release notes](https://pulsar.apache.org/release-notes/): Notes for individual releases.
- [Java API reference](https://pulsar.apache.org/api/): Javadoc for the Pulsar Java client.
- [Admin REST API reference](https://pulsar.apache.org/admin-rest-api/): HTTP API for cluster administration.
- [Blog](https://pulsar.apache.org/blog/): Announcements and technical posts.
- [Contributor guide](https://pulsar.apache.org/contribute/): How to contribute to Apache Pulsar.
